name: Nova Scotia
title: Nova Scotia Rebate Calculator 2026: Efficiency Nova Scotia and Income-Based Help
h1: Nova Scotia Rebate Calculator 2026: What You Could Get Back
desc: Free Nova Scotia rebate calculator. Efficiency Nova Scotia heat pump, insulation and water heater rebates plus income-based top-ups, with the official source for every amount.
intro: Answer a few questions and see which Nova Scotia rebates fit your home, with a source for every number.
short: Efficiency Nova Scotia pays up to $5,000 back on upgrades from a Home Energy Assessment: $300 per ton for a ductless heat pump, $500 per ton for a ducted one and $600 per ton for geothermal. A heat pump water heater gets $800. Homes without electric heat and under the income limits can add up to $5,000 more. The oil-to-heat-pump program closed on July 2, 2026.
faq: How much is the Nova Scotia heat pump rebate in 2026?

$300 per ton for a ductless mini-split, $500 per ton of new capacity for a centrally ducted heat pump and $600 per ton for geothermal, through a Home Energy Assessment. Replacement heat pumps are not eligible, and total assessment rebates are capped at $5,000.
Is the oil-to-heat-pump program still open in Nova Scotia?
No. It closed to new applicants on July 2, 2026 when the funding was fully allocated.
What is the Moderate Income Rebate?

A top-up for homeowners with mostly non-electric heat and after-tax household income under the limits. It is now capped at $5,000 and stacks with the assessment rebates for up to $10,000 in total. It must be approved before the work starts.
Is there a solar or battery rebate in Nova Scotia?
Not for homeowners. SolarHomes closed in April 2025 and we found no current residential battery rebate.

programs.name: Efficiency Nova Scotia: ductless heat pump
programs.rules: Through a Home Energy Assessment. Model on the ENS list, installed by a certified contractor. Replacement heat pumps are not eligible.

programs.name: Efficiency Nova Scotia: central ducted heat pump
programs.rules: Paid per ton of newly added capacity, through a Home Energy Assessment. Replacement heat pumps and ducted mini-splits are not eligible.

programs.name: Efficiency Nova Scotia: geothermal heat pump
programs.rules: Through a Home Energy Assessment. Replacement heat pumps are not eligible.

programs.name: Moderate Income Rebate: ductless heat pump top-up
programs.rules: For homeowners with mostly non-electric heat under the income limits. Must be approved before the work starts.

programs.name: Moderate Income Rebate: ducted heat pump top-up
programs.rules: For homeowners with mostly non-electric heat under the income limits. Must be approved before the work starts.

programs.name: Efficiency Nova Scotia: heat pump water heater
programs.rules: ENERGY STAR model. The same $800 is paid instantly at participating stores, or through the assessment if you did not take the instant rebate.

programs.name: Efficiency Nova Scotia: insulation
programs.rules: Attic to R-50 up to $750, exterior walls up to $1,500, basement walls up to $1,200. Paid by the share of area insulated, through a Home Energy Assessment.

programs.name: Instant rebate: smart thermostat
programs.rules: At participating stores, and online at getmysa.com. Only for thermostats that control electric heat.

programs.name: Free smart thermostat installation
programs.rules: For electrically heated homes on the residential rate that have an analog or non-programmable thermostat.

programs.name: Moderate Income Rebate
programs.rules: A top-up on other upgrades too, for homeowners with mostly non-electric heat under the after-tax income limits. Together with the assessment rebates you can reach $10,000. Must be approved before the work starts.

programs.name: HomeWarming (free upgrades)
programs.rules: Free insulation, draft-proofing and heat pumps for lower-income homeowners, with a free home energy assessment. Wait times are long.

programs.name: Heating Assistance Rebate Program
programs.rules: A yearly rebate for lower-income households, including renters who pay their own electric heat. 2026-27 applications open October 1, 2026 and the amount is not posted yet.

programs.name: National Heat Pump Rebate (federal, not open yet)
programs.rules: Announced October 8, 2026 and expected to launch in early 2027. $10,000 is for households below the median income and $2,000 for other eligible homeowners. The income line and eligible homes are not published, so this is shown but not added to your total.

notes: We found no current Efficiency Nova Scotia battery rebate. Homeowner solar rebates ended in April 2025.
Amounts are the most a program pays. Your rebate depends on the equipment and your final invoice.
